title: A tour to see Barcelona from a different perspective
text: We were led on a ghost tour by a tour guide named Nil. He was a kind and attentive guide and his fascinating commentary made for a different Barcelona tour. I'm very happy to be exposed to the slightly scary hidden secrets of Barcelona.

title: Barcelona Ghost Night Walking Tour
text: It was a wonderful tour. Stories were very entertaining. Only thing that would have made it perfect would be if guide returned us to the point we started from (arc de truimf)

title: A Unique Way to Tour the City
text: I love ghost tours and try to find one in every city I am visiting! This was a wonderful way to see the sights and learn some of the legends of Barcelona. Our tour guide was an AMAZING and very animated story teller. I was on the English/Spanish tour and her transition between the two languages made the stories even more captivating. We had a large group, which was fine for the most part, but would have preferred a group . of maybe 8 max.
author: Jenna I

title: Ghost Tour
text: The tour guide was excellent and made the tour fun!  We enjoyed the stories and sights.  If you like to hear stories and see that side of a city this is the tour for you.
